study: NIFTY 50 next-session direction: preliminary candidate-rule diagnostic
data_source: Committed daily OHLC CSV; third-party Yahoo Finance series, not exchange-certified
method: Fixed rules applied to the same date range as the verified benchmark; direction is based only on close through t; gross long/short index proxy equals predicted sign times next-session index return.
conclusion: No candidate improves balanced accuracy over the previous-session-direction baseline. The 20-session trend filter has the highest candidate balanced accuracy among new rules (53.90%) but remains below the baseline (54.10%). No strategy is validated.
limitations: Preliminary independent calculation; automated Python script run must confirm the exact output before promotion to final result.
Gross index proxy, not a tradable instrument; no costs, slippage, brokerage, taxes, basis, margin, liquidity or execution timing included.
Volatility-conditioned rule uses an approximate expanding quantile calculation in this preliminary diagnostic; its exact Python result may differ slightly.
No parameter tuning was performed; these results do not establish a profitable strategy.
